body:
### UTC Date & Time

[October 19, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/oct-19-2026/2pm)

### Agenda

### Discussions

#### Glamsterdam

- Glamsterdam network updates: Sepolia (forked Oct 6), devnet-8 (benchmarking), devnet-12, mainnet shadow forks.
  - Led by Protocol Devops
- Revisit [ethereum/consensus-specs#5736](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5736) (separate builder and validator deposits at the Gloas fork): not for Hoodi; prototype, merge after Hoodi, test on a short-lived devnet, don't delay mainnet ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6223076039)).
  - Led by @jtraglia
- Hoodi: fork Mon Oct 26, 17:42:48 UTC (epoch 132352), gas limit 200M at the fork. Release status vs the [EF blog post](https://blog.ethereum.org/en/2026/10/16/glamsterdam-hoodi-announcement): Geth, Erigon, Reth releases with Hoodi support still pending.
  - Led by @danceratopz
- BAL retention: ELs keep BALs available via `engine_getPayloadBodiesBy*V2` for 14,299 epochs ([ethereum/EIPs#12347](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12347)). Per-EL status and a finality clause for CLs that blind unfinalized payloads ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6261344696)).
  - Led by @nerolation

#### Hegota

- Heads up: suggested scoping process change: unmerged EIPs stay off call agendas; PFI'd EIPs without client support default to DFI ([ethereum/pm#2275](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/pull/2275)). Please review before ACDE #248.
  - Led by @barnabasbusa
- Hegota devnets: `heze-devnet-1` (FOCIL) and `bogota-devnet-1` (frames) are live.
  - `heze-devnet-2` alignment ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6193239941)): CL slot duration (12s?), EL blob schedule (12/18 or 14/21?), IL deadline ([ethereum/consensus-specs#5727](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5727) in?).
  - Led by @danceratopz
- Hegota devnet plan: `hegota-devnet-0` before Mumbai? Lock `hegota-devnet-1` EL scope: EIP-8298, EIP-8131, EIP-8279, EIP-8253, EIP-4758 ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6265056113)).
  - Led by @spencer-tb
- Name for I*, the CL upgrade after Heze ([Magicians thread](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/i-star-name-for-consensus-layer-upgrade-after-heze/26717)).
  - Led by @barnabasbusa

### EL breakout

- discv5 defaults: confirm discv5 is on by default in each EL's Hoodi release.
- BPO test forks based on Amsterdam: `BPO2ToBPO3` -> `AmsterdamToBPOIncrease`, `BPO3ToBPO4` -> `BPOIncreaseToBPODecrease` ([ethereum/execution-specs#3597](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3597)). No changes needed for Erigon, ethrex, Nethermind, Reth; PRs for Besu ([besu-eth/besu#11646](https://github.com/besu-eth/besu/pull/11646)), Geth ([ethereum/go-ethereum#35975](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/35975)), Nimbus-EL ([status-im/nimbus-eth1#5012](https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth1/pull/5012)).
  - Led by @danceratopz
- Heads up: EELS hive simulators as prebuilt images ([ethereum/execution-specs#3572](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3572), [ethereum/hive#1609](https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/1609)): simulator builds drop from 100+ s to seconds; select releases with `--sim.buildarg tag=<tag>`. Client CI PRs to review for Erigon, ethrex, Nethermind, Reth.
  - Led by @spencer-tb

### CL breakout

- [ethereum/beacon-APIs#627](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627) (`produceBlockV4WithBid`): ship as Experimental? ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6217620985))
  - Led by @eth2353
- [ethereum/consensus-specs#5727](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5727) on `heze-devnet-2` ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6257399197))
  - Led by @rolfyone

### Call Series

All Core Devs - Testing

### Autopilot Mode

- [x] Use autopilot (recommended defaults for this call series)

weekly

comments.body:
Need to clarify alignment for `heze-devnet-2`:

- Blob schedule (EL)
- Slot duration (CL)

I'd like to discuss https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627 on the CL breakout one more time, I recently added more motivation behind the requested API endpoint to the PR [here](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627#issuecomment-6012901023).

I've confirmed interest in this endpoint from multi-node validator clients (Vero, Vouch) and DVT (Obol). This endpoint makes a lot of sense for these setups.

If it makes people more comfortable, I'd be happy to tag this endpoint as `Experimental` and have all consumers treat it that way (off by default, behind a dangerous/experimental flag, ...).

In the CL breakout call, I would like to revisit the idea of [altering the function which onboards builders](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5736) at the fork. My opinion on the matter has evolved and I'm now slightly in favor of making the change. Concretely, I suggest the following:

* Do not make this change for Hoodi; that ship has sailed.
* Have clients prototype the change to confirm it's not too difficult.
* After Hoodi upgrades successfully, merge this PR & make a release.
* Confirm/test this change with a short-lived devnet like devnet-12.
* Do not delay the Glamsterdam upgrade for Mainnet.

I'm not especially happy to be making such a last-minute change but I believe it would be a lot easier for us to make this change so that it doesn't require every other DVT system to incorporate a fix. We should have sufficient time (a few weeks) to deal with this before Mainnet releases are published.
Im curious whether https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5727 is planned for heze-devnet-2 , currently its not on the teku devnet branch

I'd like to sync with EL clients on BAL retention windows - best doing it in the general section of the call as this is relevant for CLs too.
Goal is to merge https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12347

In the Hegota devnets section can we touch upon `hegota-devnet-0`? Is the plan to still launch this before Mumbai?

Could we also agree on what EIPs to add to `hegota-devnet-1` (more relevant for the EL as lots of EIPs this fork). Maybe lock in a loose date? 2 weeks after Mumbai?

Last week we loosely acknowledged adding the following on the EL, could we agree on this today:
> - EIP-8298 SETCODEFROM
> - EIP-8131 Unified Transaction Content Floor
> - EIP-8279 Block Access List Byte Floor
> - EIP-8253 Bump nonce of zero-nonce storage accounts (critical to test earlier)
> - EIP-4758 Deactivate SELFDESTRUCT (reduces tests)

For me having D+2 lookahead for devnets is ideal from a planning perspective. We can always change and add last minute EIPs. This will give client teams who have extra bandwidth to help us clarify the spec for these EIPs earlier!

Would be good to start discussing what name we wanna use for I*. Couldn't find an active poll but did find this: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/i-star-name-for-consensus-layer-upgrade-after-heze/26717/2
Probably a topic for ACDC/E but I'd like to bring up https://github.com/ethereum/pm/pull/2275 which changes the process a little bit, possibly helping us move a bit quicker scoping out new forks.

Hey, @spencer-tb and I would like to bring up these two topics in the EL breakout:
- Move BPO test forks to be based on Amsterdam and rename them from BPO3/BPO4 to BPOIncrease/BPODecrease.
- execution-specs hive simulators will be published as docker images soooon: Build time reduces from ~100s -> ~seconds.
